tools.name: search_oneway_flights
tools.description:
FlightPowers one-way fare search: live prices read from Google Flights, not schedules.

IMPORTANT: for any flexible search, make ONE call with a date range and/or several destinations. Do NOT call this repeatedly, once per date -- pass departure_date_from and departure_date_to and the server searche

tools.name: search_roundtrip_flights
tools.description:
FlightPowers round-trip fare search: live prices read from Google Flights, priced as paired legs rather than two separate one-ways.

IMPORTANT: for any flexible search, make ONE call. Pass departure_date_from / departure_date_to for a departure range, and `nights` instead of return_date to search tr

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description:
FlightPowers hotel search: live Booking.com availability and nightly prices for a destination and date range. Input: a free-text destination the way a person would say it ("Rome", "Tokyo Shibuya"), plus check-in and check-out dates.

Returns each property's price, review score, room type, latitude/l

tools.name: find_hotel_by_name
tools.description:
FlightPowers single-property lookup: live Booking.com availability and pricing for one named property. Input: the hotel name a person would type (adding the city helps when a chain has many properties) plus check-in and check-out dates -- no internal property ID needed.

Returns the property's price
